translations.en.sahih: By the star when it descends,
translations.en.pickthall: By the Star when it setteth,
translations.en.yusufali: By the Star when it goes down,-
translations.id.indonesian: Demi bintang ketika terbenam.

transliteration: Maa dalla saahibukum wa maa ghawaa

translations.en.sahih: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,
translations.en.pickthall: Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived;
translations.en.yusufali: Your Companion is neither astray nor being misled.
translations.id.indonesian: kawanmu (Muhammad) tidak sesat dan tidak pula keliru.

translations.en.sahih: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.
translations.en.pickthall: Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire.
translations.en.yusufali: Nor does he say (aught) of (his own) Desire.
translations.id.indonesian: dan tiadalah yang diucapkannya itu (Al-Quran) menurut kemauan hawa nafsunya.

translations.en.sahih: It is not but a revelation revealed,
translations.en.pickthall: It is naught save an inspiration that is inspired,
translations.en.yusufali: It is no less than inspiration sent down to him:
translations.id.indonesian: Ucapannya itu tiada lain hanyalah wahyu yang diwahyukan (kepadanya).

translations.en.sahih: Taught to him by one intense in strength -
translations.en.pickthall: Which one of mighty powers hath taught him,
translations.en.yusufali: He was taught by one Mighty in Power,
translations.id.indonesian: yang diajarkan kepadanya oleh (Jibril) yang sangat kuat.

translations.en.sahih: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
translations.en.pickthall: One vigorous; and he grew clear to view
translations.en.yusufali: Endued with Wisdom: for he appeared (in stately form);
translations.id.indonesian: yang mempunyai akal yang cerdas; dan (Jibril itu) menampakkan diri dengan rupa yang asli.

translations.en.sahih: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.
translations.en.pickthall: When he was on the uppermost horizon.
translations.en.yusufali: While he was in the highest part of the horizon:
translations.id.indonesian: sedang dia berada di ufuk yang tinggi.

translations.en.sahih: Then he approached and descended
translations.en.pickthall: Then he drew nigh and came down
translations.en.yusufali: Then he approached and came closer,
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian dia mendekat, lalu bertambah dekat lagi.

translations.en.sahih: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.
translations.en.pickthall: Till he was (distant) two bows' length or even nearer,
translations.en.yusufali: And was at a distance of but two bow-lengths or (even) nearer;
translations.id.indonesian: maka jadilah dia dekat (pada Muhammad sejarak) dua ujung busur panah atau lebih dekat (lagi).

translations.en.sahih: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed.
translations.en.pickthall: And He revealed unto His slave that which He revealed.
translations.en.yusufali: So did (Allah) convey the inspiration to His Servant- (conveyed) what He (meant) to convey.
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu dia menyampaikan kepada hamba-Nya (Muhammad) apa yang telah Allah wahyukan.

transliteration: Maa kazabal fu'aadu maa ra aa

translations.en.sahih: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.
translations.en.pickthall: The heart lied not (in seeing) what it saw.
translations.en.yusufali: The (Prophet's) (mind and) heart in no way falsified that which he saw.
translations.id.indonesian: Hatinya tidak mendustakan apa yang telah dilihatnya.

translations.en.sahih: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?
translations.en.pickthall: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he seeth?
translations.en.yusufali: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he saw?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah kaum (musyrik Mekah) hendak membantahnya tentang apa yang telah dilihatnya?

transliteration: Wa laqad ra aahu nazlatan ukhraa

translations.en.sahih: And he certainly saw him in another descent
translations.en.pickthall: And verily he saw him yet another time
translations.en.yusufali: For indeed he saw him at a second descent,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Muhammad telah melihat Jibril itu (dalam rupanya yang asli) pada waktu yang lain,

translations.en.sahih: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
translations.en.pickthall: By the lote-tree of the utmost boundary,
translations.en.yusufali: Near the Lote-tree beyond which none may pass:
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) di Sidratil Muntaha.

translations.en.sahih: Near it is the Garden of Refuge -
translations.en.pickthall: Nigh unto which is the Garden of Abode.
translations.en.yusufali: Near it is the Garden of Abode.
translations.id.indonesian: Di dekatnya ada surga tempat tinggal,

translations.en.sahih: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].
translations.en.pickthall: When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote-tree,
translations.en.yusufali: Behold, the Lote-tree was shrouded (in mystery unspeakable!)
translations.id.indonesian: (Muhammad melihat Jibril) ketika Sidratil Muntaha diliputi oleh sesuatu yang meliputinya.

transliteration: Maa zaaghal basaru wa maa taghaa

translations.en.sahih: The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].
translations.en.pickthall: The eye turned not aside nor yet was overbold.
translations.en.yusufali: (His) sight never swerved, nor did it go wrong!
translations.id.indonesian: Penglihatannya (muhammad) tidak berpaling dari yang dilihatnya itu dan tidak (pula) melampauinya.

arabic: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
transliteration: Laqad ra aa min aayaati Rabbihil kubraaa

translations.en.sahih: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
translations.en.pickthall: Verily he saw one of the greater revelations of his Lord.
translations.en.yusufali: For truly did he see, of the Signs of his Lord, the Greatest!
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya dia telah melihat sebahagian tanda-tanda (kekuasaan) Tuhannya yang paling besar.

translations.en.sahih: So have you considered al-Lat and al-'Uzza?
translations.en.pickthall: Have ye thought upon Al-Lat and Al-'Uzza
translations.en.yusufali: Have ye seen Lat. and 'Uzza,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah patut kamu (hai orang-orang musyrik) menganggap al Lata dan al Uzza,

translations.en.sahih: And Manat, the third - the other one?
translations.en.pickthall: And Manat, the third, the other?
translations.en.yusufali: And another, the third (goddess), Manat?
translations.id.indonesian: dan Manah yang ketiga, yang paling terkemudian (sebagai anak perempuan Allah)?

translations.en.sahih: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
translations.en.pickthall: Are yours the males and His the females?
translations.en.yusufali: What! for you the male sex, and for Him, the female?
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah (patut) untuk kamu (anak) laki-laki dan untuk Allah (anak) perempuan?

translations.en.sahih: That, then, is an unjust division.
translations.en.pickthall: That indeed were an unfair division!
translations.en.yusufali: Behold, such would be indeed a division most unfair!
translations.id.indonesian: Yang demikian itu tentulah suatu pembagian yang tidak adil.

arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
transliteration: In hiya illaaa asmaaa'un sammaitumoohaaa antum wa aabaaa'ukum maaa anzalal laahu bihaa min sultaan; inyyattabi'oona illaz zanna wa maa tahwal anfusu wa laqad jaaa'ahum mir Rabbihimul hudaa

translations.en.sahih: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
translations.en.pickthall: They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them.
translations.en.yusufali: These are nothing but names which ye have devised,- ye and your fathers,- for which Allah has sent down no authority (whatever). They follow nothing but conjecture and what their own souls desire!- Even though there has already come to them Guidance from their Lord!
translations.id.indonesian: Itu tidak lain hanyalah nama-nama yang kamu dan bapak-bapak kamu mengadakannya; Allah tidak menurunkan suatu keteranganpun untuk (menyembah)nya. Mereka tidak lain hanyalah mengikuti sangkaan-sangkaan, dan apa yang diingini oleh hawa nafsu mereka dan sesungguhnya telah datang petunjuk kepada mereka dari Tuhan mereka.

transliteration: Am lil insaani maa taman naa

translations.en.sahih: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
translations.en.pickthall: Or shall man have what he coveteth?
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, shall man have (just) anything he hankers after?
translations.id.indonesian: Atau apakah manusia akan mendapat segala yang dicita-citakannya?

translations.en.sahih: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
translations.en.pickthall: But unto Allah belongeth the after (life), and the former.
translations.en.yusufali: But it is to Allah that the End and the Beginning (of all things) belong.
translations.id.indonesian: (Tidak), maka hanya bagi Allah kehidupan akhirat dan kehidupan dunia.

arabic: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
transliteration: Wa kam mim malakin fissamaawaati laa tughnee shafaa'atuhum shai'an illaa mim ba'di anyyaazanal laahu limany yashaaa'u wa yardaa

translations.en.sahih: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.
translations.en.pickthall: And how many angels are in the heavens whose intercession availeth naught save after Allah giveth leave to whom He chooseth and accepteth.
translations.en.yusufali: How many-so-ever be the angels in the heavens, their intercession will avail nothing except after Allah has given leave for whom He pleases and that he is acceptable to Him.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan berapa banyaknya malaikat di langit, syafa'at mereka sedikitpun tidak berguna, kecuali sesudah Allah mengijinkan bagi orang yang dikehendaki dan diridhai (Nya).

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
transliteration: innal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil aakhirati la yusammoonal malaaa'ikata tasmiyatal unsaa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter who name the angels with the names of females.
translations.en.yusufali: Those who believe not in the Hereafter, name the angels with female names.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang tiada beriman kepada kehidupan akhirat, mereka benar-benar menamakan malaikat itu dengan nama perempuan.

arabic: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا
transliteration: Wa maa lahum bihee min 'ilmin iny yattabi'oona illaz zanna wa innaz zanna laa yughnee minal haqqi shai'aa

translations.en.sahih: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.
translations.en.pickthall: And they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and lo! a guess can never take the place of the truth.
translations.en.yusufali: But they have no knowledge therein. They follow nothing but conjecture; and conjecture avails nothing against Truth.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka tidak mempunyai sesuatu pengetahuanpun tentang itu. Mereka tidak lain hanyalah mengikuti persangkaan sedang sesungguhnya persangkaan itu tiada berfaedah sedikitpun terhadap kebenaran.

arabic: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
transliteration: Fa a'rid 'am man tawallaa 'an zikrinaa wa lam yurid illal hayaatad dunyaa

translations.en.sahih: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
translations.en.pickthall: Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world.
translations.en.yusufali: Therefore shun those who turn away from Our Message and desire nothing but the life of this world.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka berpalinglah (hai Muhammad) dari orang yang berpaling dari peringatan Kami, dan tidak mengingini kecuali kehidupan duniawi.

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
transliteration: Zalika mablaghuhum minal 'ilm; inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu biman dalla 'an sabee lihee wa huwa a'lamu bimanih tadaa

translations.en.sahih: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.
translations.en.pickthall: Such is their sum of knowledge. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth, and He is Best Aware of him whom goeth right.
translations.en.yusufali: That is as far as knowledge will reach them. Verily thy Lord knoweth best those who stray from His Path, and He knoweth best those who receive guidance.
translations.id.indonesian: Itulah sejauh-jauh pengetahuan mereka. Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu, Dialah yang paling mengetahui siapa yang tersesat dari jalan-Nya dan Dia pulalah yang paling mengetahui siapa yang mendapat petunjuk.

arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
transliteration: Wa lillaahi maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ardi liyajziyal lazeena asaaa'oo bimaa 'amiloo wa yajziyal lazeena ahsanoo bilhusnaa

translations.en.sahih: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -
translations.en.pickthall: And unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may reward those who do evil with that which they have done, and reward those who do good with goodness.
translations.en.yusufali: Yea, to Allah belongs all that is in the heavens and on earth: so that He rewards those who do evil, according to their deeds, and He rewards those who do good, with what is best.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan hanya kepunyaan Allah-lah apa yang ada di langit dan apa yang ada di bumi supaya Dia memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang berbuat jahat terhadap apa yang telah mereka kerjakan dan memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang berbuat baik dengan pahala yang lebih baik (surga).

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
transliteration: Allazeena yajtaniboona kabaaa'iral ismi walfawaa hisha illal lamam; inna rabbaka waasi'ul maghfirah; huwa a'lamu bikum iz ansha akum minal ardi wa iz antum ajinnatun fee butooni umma haatikum falaa tuzakkooo anfusakum huwa a'lamu bimanit taqaa

translations.en.sahih: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
translations.en.pickthall: Those who avoid enormities of sin and abominations, save the unwilled offences - (for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy. He is Best Aware of you (from the time) when He created you from the earth, and when ye were hidden in the bellies of your mothers. Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves. He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil).
translations.en.yusufali: Those who avoid great sins and shameful deeds, only (falling into) small faults,- verily thy Lord is ample in forgiveness. He knows you well when He brings you out of the earth, And when ye are hidden in your mothers' wombs. Therefore justify not yourselves: He knows best who it is that guards against evil.
translations.id.indonesian: (Yaitu) orang-orang yang menjauhi dosa-dosa besar dan perbuatan keji yang selain dari kesalahan-kesalahan kecil. Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu maha luas ampunan-Nya. Dan Dia lebih mengetahui (tentang keadaan)mu ketika Dia menjadikan kamu dari tanah dan ketika kamu masih janin dalam perut ibumu; maka janganlah kamu mengatakan dirimu suci. Dialah yang paling mengetahui tentang orang yang bertakwa.

translations.en.sahih: Have you seen the one who turned away
translations.en.pickthall: Didst thou (O Muhammad) observe him who turned away,
translations.en.yusufali: Seest thou one who turns back,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah kamu melihat orang yang berpaling (dari Al-Quran)?

translations.en.sahih: And gave a little and [then] refrained?
translations.en.pickthall: And gave a little, then was grudging?
translations.en.yusufali: Gives a little, then hardens (his heart)?
translations.id.indonesian: serta memberi sedikit dan tidak mau memberi lagi?

translations.en.sahih: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?
translations.en.pickthall: Hath he knowledge of the Unseen so that he seeth?
translations.en.yusufali: What! Has he knowledge of the Unseen so that he can see?
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah dia mempunyai pengetahuan tentang yang ghaib, sehingga dia mengetahui (apa yang dikatakan)?

arabic: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
transliteration: Am lam yunabbaa bimaa fee suhuhfi Moosa

translations.en.sahih: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
translations.en.pickthall: Or hath he not had news of what is in the books of Moses
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, is he not acquainted with what is in the Books of Moses-
translations.id.indonesian: Ataukah belum diberitakan kepadanya apa yang ada dalam lembaran-lembaran Musa?

translations.en.sahih: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -
translations.en.pickthall: And Abraham who paid his debt:
translations.en.yusufali: And of Abraham who fulfilled his engagements?-
translations.id.indonesian: dan lembaran-lembaran Ibrahim yang selalu menyempurnakan janji?

translations.en.sahih: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
translations.en.pickthall: That no laden one shall bear another's load,
translations.en.yusufali: Namely, that no bearer of burdens can bear the burden of another;
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) bahwasanya seorang yang berdosa tidak akan memikul dosa orang lain,

arabic: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
transliteration: Wa al laisa lil insaani illaa maa sa'aa

translations.en.sahih: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
translations.en.pickthall: And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort,
translations.en.yusufali: That man can have nothing but what he strives for;
translations.id.indonesian: dan bahwasanya seorang manusia tiada memperoleh selain apa yang telah diusahakannya,

translations.en.sahih: And that his effort is going to be seen -
translations.en.pickthall: And that his effort will be seen.
translations.en.yusufali: That (the fruit of) his striving will soon come in sight:
translations.id.indonesian: dan bahwasanya usaha itu kelak akan diperlihatkan (kepadanya).

translations.en.sahih: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense
translations.en.pickthall: And afterward he will be repaid for it with fullest payment;
translations.en.yusufali: Then will he be rewarded with a reward complete;
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian akan diberi balasan kepadanya dengan balasan yang paling sempurna,

translations.en.sahih: And that to your Lord is the finality
translations.en.pickthall: And that thy Lord, He is the goal;
translations.en.yusufali: That to thy Lord is the final Goal;
translations.id.indonesian: dan bahwasanya kepada Tuhanmulah kesudahan (segala sesuatu),

transliteration: Wa annahoo huwa adhaka wa abkaa

translations.en.sahih: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
translations.en.pickthall: And that He it is who maketh laugh, and maketh weep,
translations.en.yusufali: That it is He Who granteth Laughter and Tears;
translations.id.indonesian: dan bahwasanya Dialah yang menjadikan orang tertawa dan menangis,

transliteration: Wa annahoo huwa amaata wa ahyaa

translations.en.sahih: And that it is He who causes death and gives life
translations.en.pickthall: And that He it is Who giveth death and giveth life;
translations.en.yusufali: That it is He Who granteth Death and Life;
translations.id.indonesian: dan bahwasanya Dialah yang mematikan dan menghidupkan,

transliteration: Wa annahoo khalaqaz zawjainiz zakara wal unsaa

translations.en.sahih: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
translations.en.pickthall: And that He createth the two spouses, the male and the female,
translations.en.yusufali: That He did create in pairs,- male and female,
translations.id.indonesian: dan bahwasanya Dialah yang menciptakan berpasang-pasangan pria dan wanita.

translations.en.sahih: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
translations.en.pickthall: From a drop (of seed) when it is poured forth;
translations.en.yusufali: From a seed when lodged (in its place);
translations.id.indonesian: dari air mani, apabila dipancarkan.

translations.en.sahih: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the next creation
translations.en.pickthall: And that He hath ordained the second bringing forth;
translations.en.yusufali: That He hath promised a Second Creation (Raising of the Dead);
translations.id.indonesian: Dan bahwasanya Dialah yang menetapkan kejadian yang lain (kebangkitan sesudah mati),

transliteration: Wa annahoo huwa aghnaa wa aqnaa

translations.en.sahih: And that it is He who enriches and suffices
translations.en.pickthall: And that He it is Who enricheth and contenteth;
translations.en.yusufali: That it is He Who giveth wealth and satisfaction;
translations.id.indonesian: dan bahwasanya Dia yang memberikan kekayaan dan memberikan kecukupan,

translations.en.sahih: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius
translations.en.pickthall: And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius;
translations.en.yusufali: That He is the Lord of Sirius (the Mighty Star);
translations.id.indonesian: dan bahwasanya Dialah yang Tuhan (yang memiliki) bintang syi'ra,

translations.en.sahih: And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad
translations.en.pickthall: And that He destroyed the former (tribe of) A'ad,
translations.en.yusufali: And that it is He Who destroyed the (powerful) ancient 'Ad (people),
translations.id.indonesian: dan bahwasanya Dia telah membinasakan kaum 'Aad yang pertama,

translations.en.sahih: And Thamud - and He did not spare [them] -
translations.en.pickthall: And (the tribe of) Thamud He spared not;
translations.en.yusufali: And the Thamud nor gave them a lease of perpetual life.
translations.id.indonesian: dan kaum Tsamud. Maka tidak seorangpun yang ditinggalkan-Nya (hidup).

arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
transliteration: Wa qawma Noohim min qablu innahum kaanoo hum azlama wa atghaa

translations.en.sahih: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
translations.en.pickthall: And the folk of Noah aforetime, Lo! they were more unjust and more rebellious;
translations.en.yusufali: And before them, the people of Noah, for that they were (all) most unjust and most insolent transgressors,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kaum Nuh sebelum itu. Sesungguhnya mereka adalah orang-orang yang paling zalim dan paling durhaka,

translations.en.sahih: And the overturned towns He hurled down
translations.en.pickthall: And Al-Mu'tafikah He destroyed
translations.en.yusufali: And He destroyed the Overthrown Cities (of Sodom and Gomorrah).
translations.id.indonesian: dan negeri-negeri kaum Luth yang telah dihancurkan Allah.

translations.en.sahih: And covered them by that which He covered.
translations.en.pickthall: So that there covered them that which did cover.
translations.en.yusufali: So that (ruins unknown) have covered them up.
translations.id.indonesian: lalu Allah menimpakan atas negeri itu azab besar yang menimpanya.

translations.en.sahih: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?
translations.en.pickthall: Concerning which then, of the bounties of thy Lord, canst thou dispute?
translations.en.yusufali: Then which of the gifts of thy Lord, (O man,) wilt thou dispute about?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka terhadap nikmat Tuhanmu yang manakah kamu ragu-ragu?

translations.en.sahih: This [Prophet] is a warner like the former warners.
translations.en.pickthall: This is a warner of the warners of old.
translations.en.yusufali: This is a Warner, of the (series of) Warners of old!
translations.id.indonesian: Ini (Muhammad) adalah seorang pemberi peringatan di antara pemberi-pemberi peringatan yang terdahulu.

translations.en.sahih: The Approaching Day has approached.
translations.en.pickthall: The threatened Hour is nigh.
translations.en.yusufali: The (Judgment) ever approaching draws nigh:
translations.id.indonesian: Telah dekat terjadinya hari kiamat.

arabic: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
transliteration: Laisa lahaa min doonil laahi kaashifah

translations.en.sahih: Of it, [from those] besides Allah, there is no remover.
translations.en.pickthall: None beside Allah can disclose it.
translations.en.yusufali: No (soul) but Allah can lay it bare.
translations.id.indonesian: Tidak ada yang akan menyatakan terjadinya hari itu selain Allah.

translations.en.sahih: Then at this statement do you wonder?
translations.en.pickthall: Marvel ye then at this statement,
translations.en.yusufali: Do ye then wonder at this recital?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah kamu merasa heran terhadap pemberitaan ini?

translations.en.sahih: And you laugh and do not weep
translations.en.pickthall: And laugh and not weep,
translations.en.yusufali: And will ye laugh and not weep,-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kamu mentertawakan dan tidak menangis?

translations.en.sahih: While you are proudly sporting?
translations.en.pickthall: While ye amuse yourselves?
translations.en.yusufali: Wasting your time in vanities?
translations.id.indonesian: Sedang kamu melengahkan(nya)?

translations.en.sahih: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him].
translations.en.pickthall: Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him.
translations.en.yusufali: But fall ye down in prostration to Allah, and adore (Him)!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka bersujudlah kepada Allah dan sembahlah (Dia).
